query: WITH RECURSIVE subtree AS (SELECT id FROM central.workflow_nodes WHERE id = $1::uuid UNION ALL SELECT n.id FROM central.workflow_nodes n JOIN subtree s ON n.parent_node_id = s.id ) SELECT n.id, n.node_key, n.state, n.not_before FROM central.workflow_nodes n WHERE n.id IN (SELECT id FROM subtree) ORDER BY n.node_key FOR UPDATE
